feeds.title: Living Passages Blog
feeds.description: The Word of God comes alive on our inspirational Christian travel experiences and authentic Bible study tours designed for Berean believers of all ages! Our Christian travel blog features info on our authentic Biblical tour destinations, unique travel tips, and the latest discoveries in biblical archaeology.

feeds.title: Biblical Israel Tours Blog
feeds.description: Biblical Israel Tours is an evangelical non-profit ministry that does two primary things. One is we lead highly biblical tours to Israel and second is we offer 'Physical Settings of the Bible' teaching seminars for churches and schools. We inspire one's journey of faith by connecting people to the land of the Bible.

feeds.title: Ferrell's Travel Blog
feeds.description: Ferrell's Travel Blog is commenting on biblical studies, archaeology, travel, and photography.

feeds.title: There Goes Connie Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Connie Pearson. I love my life as a travel writer and blogger. I love discovering the cultural distinctions of places around the country and the globe, and I enjoy sampling regional cuisine. People and their stories fascinate me.

feeds.title: City Express Travel Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Andy Kumar; owner and founder of City Express Travel. It's an honor to serve Churches & Christian schools across the USA since 1986. I now have the privilege to serve along with both of my sons; Simeon & Tim Kumar. Our 35+ years of knowledge in the travel industry has given us insight on how to find the best airfare for your trip! Explore our tips and insights in traveling as Christians in the blog.

feeds.title: Immanuel Tours Blog
feeds.description: Interested in learning more about Israel? Check out our blog where you'll find interesting information about the country, useful tips for travel, & more! Since it's beginning, Immanuel Tours has been a family-owned and operated company, taking personal interest and responsibility in providing our brothers and sisters in Christ with the utmost service as we introduce them to the home of their faith to explore its history, culture and learn how it all fits together to show a complete story of God's grace.

feeds.title: friendshiptours.com Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Friendship Tours, a Christian group travel company specializing in pilgrimage & Christian tours to the Holy Land as well as worldwide tours for Christian groups. Discover traveling tips for devoted Christians along with the latest news in travel industry.

feeds.title: Faith Journeys Blog
feeds.description: Without a doubt, Faith Journeys is the most trusted name in Catholic Pilgrimage and Protestant Tour travel experiences. You can enrich your faith here now. Faith Journeys provides the experience and knowledge of renowned religious travel experts to deliver a comprehensive selection of competitively priced, faith-based tour packages.

feeds.title: Chris Travel Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Chris W. Join me on a luxury journey. Find here some of the hotels I have stayed at during travels, travel inspiration from all around the world for the leisure & business traveller. Cultures, nature, activities, accommodation, itineraries, tips & tricks

feeds.title: International Christian Journeys Blog
feeds.description: Blog for Christian group travel tours for Pastors and their Churches. Plan Your Christian Tours to Israel and Jordan with our tips and advice for travels.

feeds.title: Jasmine Alley
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jasmine! I'm a nature-obsessed, beauty-finding, Jesus-loving dreamer with a serious case of wanderlust. I've quit my 9-5 to become a travel blogger, and my goal is to show others how they can too! And if you love your full-time job, stick around for travel tips and inspiration!

feeds.title: Selah
feeds.description: Selah is a Christian tour operator that seeks to offer travel experiences that allow people to deepen in their faith. We primarily focus on Biblical tours to Israel, Palestine, Jordan, Greece and Turkey but also offer travel experiences to locations that are best seen on tour. Read more about our tours, facilities provided, workshops and more!
